zh.title: 國防部偵獲共艦9艘與公務船7艘持續在台海周邊活動
zh.summary: 國防部公布最新動態；偵獲9艘共艦及7艘公務船在台海活動；期間未發現共機
body: 中華民國國防部於8月27日上午正式發布最新的共機艦動態統計。依據國防部公布的監測數據，自8月26日上午6時起至8月27日上午6時止的24小時內，軍方共計偵獲9艘中共軍艦以及7艘中共公務船持續在台灣海峽周邊海域進行活動。
在該段統計時間範圍內，國防部指出並未偵獲任何中共軍機出沒或活動。國軍持續掌握周邊海空域相關動態資訊。
針對共艦與公務船在台海周邊活動的情形，國防部特別強調，國軍已於第一時間運用任務機、任務艦以及岸置飛彈系統等兵力，進行嚴密監控與妥善應處。

en.title: Taiwan MND Detects 9 PLA Navy Vessels and 7 Official Ships Near Strait
en.summary: Taiwan Ministry of National Defense detected nine PLA naval vessels and seven official ships around Taiwan Strait.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense released its latest daily military track report on August 27, 2026. According to the statistics published by the ministry, nine People's Liberation Army Navy vessels and seven Chinese official ships were detected operating around the Taiwan Strait between 6:00 a.m. on August 26 and 6:00 a.m. on August 27.
The Ministry of National Defense confirmed that no Chinese military aircraft were detected in the surrounding airspace during this 24-hour observation window.

In response to the naval and official ship presence, the ministry emphasized that Taiwan's military deployed mission aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems to closely monitor the activities and respond accordingly.
